processing.knee_angle_source: relative thigh/shank Madgwick orientation; signed Y pitch
processing.knee_angular_velocity_source: relative thigh/shank gyroscope Y-axis; ideal aligned sagittal model
processing.knee_angular_acceleration_source: finite difference of gyro-derived knee angular velocity
processing.velocity_frame_requirement: real 3D hardware requires calibrated common/anatomical frame transformation
processing.knee_derivatives: velocity from calibrated gyro Y difference; acceleration from central interiors, one-sided boundaries
processing.timestamp_processing: strict monotonic timestamps/sequences; interval tolerance 1%; no interpolation
processing.orientation_initialization: 200 zero-gyro gradient iterations using first accelerometer sample; assumes stationary initial pose and common zero yaw

synchronization.synchronization_basis: input clock metadata; sample timing checked, cross-device offset not independently measured
